note: Small campground on VT 100 in Westfield, about 8 miles from Jay Peak, with a swimming pond, a brook along the sites and an off-leash dog trail. The operator advertises direct access to ATV trails. --Claude
summary: Operator page (2027 rates): RV $50.46 + 9% tax (was $41.28), weekly/monthly cheaper; base 2 adults + 2 children, +$10/person; season May 1-Oct 11 2027; online booking, 2-night minimum; 30A/water/sewer; showers, Wi-Fi. DROP CANDIDATE: over the $50 price gate by 46 cents with no gateway exception, and 'direct access to ATV trails'. Mostly seasonal (4 nightly RV sites). Google 4.7 (41). Not waterfront kept despite the operator's brook-frontage claim.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE - PRICE: the 2027 nightly RV rate is $50.46 plus 9% Vermont tax (operator page: '2027 season rates (9% Vermont tax not included)', 'RV sites are $50.46 per night'), over the US$50 gate by $0.46. No gateway within 40 km (Jay Peak resort is not a park gateway), not a Good Sam Park, no member discount seen. The stored $41.28 was the earlier rate. Weekly $44.04 a night.

DROP CANDIDATE - ATV (operator's own wording): 'Yes, Millbrook Campground provides direct access to ATV trails in the area.' and amenity 'ATV trail access'. It reads as a general campground with an ATV side, not an OHV staging area; per the 2026-10-02 rule that is keep-with-caveat (caveat now in the note), but flagged as asked.

LONG-STAY TESTS: seasonal rates are sold ($2064.22 a season for an RV site); on the operator's map most RV pads are marked seasonal and only RV sites 10, 11, 12 and 18 are nightly (plus 9 tent sites). Mostly seasonal by count, but nightly share (about 13 of 34) passes test 4; Google 4.7 (41 reviews), so no automatic drop.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the operator says 'Most sites have frontage along a local brook' and a 2026 review of site 11 mentions 'the small brook behind us'. Imagery (stored pin area, leaf-off) shows Mill Brook along the south edge of the loop behind a continuous belt of shrubs and trees, pads ~25-35 m from the channel; no numbered site on open ground at the water. Creekside not earned without placed site numbers -> not waterfront.
